item.text: The regression is in `Enum.__new__`: after an unhashable lookup key raises `TypeError`, it only scans values recorded as unhashable, so it never compares against hashable member values such as `frozenset`. I’m checking the corresponding CPython behavior and surrounding invariants before applying the minimal patch.

        # all enum instances are actually created during class construction
        # without calling this method; this method is called by the metaclass'
        # __call__ (i.e. Color(3) ), and by pickle
